snippet.text:
/-- **[H, Thm 7.1.4], `q = 1`** (our constants), from `prop_9_4_2` at `T₀ = 10⁸` and Platt's
verification: for `x ≥ 4.9·10²⁶`, `|δ| ≤ 6·10⁵`, `S_{η₊}(δ/x, x) = η̂₊(-δ) x + E x`,
`|E| ≤ 10⁻¹⁸ + 6.24·10⁶/√x`. -/
theorem thm_7_1_4_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 600000) :
    ‖Schar χ (fun n => ((Λ n * etaPlus (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (δ / x) -
        𝓕 (fun u => (etaPlus u : ℂ)) (-δ) * x‖ ≤ (1e-18 + 6.24e6 / √x) * x := by

proof_context.conclusion: For $q=1$, $|\delta|\le6\cdot10^5$: $|S_{\eta_+}(\delta/x)-\hat\eta_+(-\delta)x|\le(10^{-18}+6.24\cdot10^6/\sqrt x)x$, an explicit bound on $\mathrm{err}_{\eta_+,\chi_T}$.
